jazz.en: Tom started playing jazz after studying classical music for many years.
jazz.zh: 在学习古典音乐多年后，汤姆开始演奏爵士了。

joke.en: Tom meant it as a joke, but nobody laughed.
joke.zh: 汤姆认为那是个玩笑，但是没人笑。

journal.en: My dad keeps a journal every day.

jeans.en: Jeans are now in fashion among girls.
jeans.zh: 现在女生穿牛仔裤很流行。

jealous.en: You must not be jealous of others' success.
jealous.zh: 不要嫉妒其他人的成功。

jail.en: Tom spent more than three years in jail.
jail.zh: 汤姆蹲了三年多的监狱。

journey.en: Reading a book can be compared to a journey.
journey.zh: 阅读一本书可以比作一次旅行。

jelly.zh: 葡萄味的果冻是我最喜欢的。

jet.zh: 这架客机降落在东京了。

jacket.en: Put this jacket on, and you'll be much warmer.
jacket.zh: 穿上外套吧！你会暖一些。

judge.en: The prisoner was brought before a judge.
judge.zh: 这个囚犯被带到法官面前。

jam.en: Please hide the blueberry jam where Takako can't see it.
jam.zh: 把蓝莓酱藏在享子看不到的地方。

judgement.en: We can rely on his judgement.
judgement.zh: 我们可以信赖他的判断。

jar.en: Tom picked up the jar and read the label.

justice.en: Justice will prevail in the end.

jupiter.en: Jupiter is the largest planet in the Solar System.
jupiter.zh: 木星是太阳系中最大的行星。

junior.en: I'm not a junior high school student.

junk.en: Tom has no idea what to do with all the junk in his garage.
junk.zh: 汤姆不知道拿他车库的那些废物怎么办。

jungle.en: He wrote a book about a jungle adventure.
jungle.zh: 他写了一本关于丛林冒险的书。

jaw.en: He got a broken jaw and lost some teeth.
jaw.zh: 他磕碎了下巴，掉了几颗牙。

justify.en: The end does not always justify the means.
justify.zh: 为了正当目的并非总是可以不择手段.

jealousy.en: Her success made her the target of jealousy.
jealousy.zh: 她的成功让她受尽嫉妒。

jesus.en: We are here in the name of Jesus Christ and King Charles.
jesus.zh: 我们这里以耶稣基督和查理斯国王之名。

joy.en: Her eyes shone with joy when she saw that her mother was not mad at her.
joy.zh: 当她看到妈妈没在生她的气，她的双眼因为幸福而闪烁了。
